headline: Semantics verified against its spec and MARS 4.5; all 7 equivalence claims behaved as claimed, including the 2 deliberately buggy variants.

gates.name: lake check
gates.detail: kernel replay of the default target; axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

equivalence.name: mul_pow2
equivalence.claim: x*8 via mult/mflo vs sll by 3

equivalence.name: div_pow2_buggy
equivalence.claim: x/4 via div/mflo vs plain sra (rounds toward -inf, not zero)

equivalence.name: div_pow2_correct
equivalence.claim: x/4 via div/mflo vs bias-corrected sra

equivalence.name: mod_pow2_buggy
equivalence.claim: x%4 via div/mfhi vs plain andi mask (always non-negative)

equivalence.name: mod_pow2_correct
equivalence.claim: x%4 via div/mfhi vs a0 - (bias-corrected quotient)*4

equivalence.name: sub_twos_complement
equivalence.claim: a0-a1 via subu vs nor+addiu+addu (two's-complement negate-and-add)

run.output: SUMMARY: all 7 equivalence cases behaved as claimed
